title: Run live rounds 1-3 on dev-100 + twins (cap 5,000 Jev)
description:
## Purpose

Run rounds 1-3 on dev-100 (+ twins) for arms 0, A-c, F, F-rand and A-c+F, plus the F-raw vs F-neutralized comparison.

## Scope

100 labels per round, one seed; guards on; analyst proposals and screen rejections logged; skew checks reported. Freeze bundles and write the final protocol before any FINAL request.

## Cost cap

Hard cap 5,000 Jev requests (about $2-3), including about 1,000 for F-raw vs F-neutralized (about $0.5).

## Definition of done

Dev-100 table (accuracy, Brier, flips, |delta P|) per arm and round; proposals and rejections listed; actual spend; frozen bundles.

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §5.2; [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
